Starbucks in SM Lanang offers a refreshing break from the typical mall-based cafe experience, primarily due to its standout location. Positioned as an "island platform" within the sprawling mall, it creates a distinct, open-air feel that sets it apart from other branches. The generous seating, both indoors and out, provides ample space for solo work or group meetups, making it a comfortable spot to linger and enjoy your coffee. The cafe's offerings are what you would expect from a Starbucks—a consistent and reliable menu of beverages and pastries that align with the brand's global standards. While the location and ambiance are unique to this branch, the food and drink options are a familiar comfort for any Starbucks enthusiast. However, a notable point for anyone planning an early visit is the discrepancy in operating hours. While online listings, including Google Maps, may indicate a general opening time of 8:00 AM, the on-site staff, as experienced firsthand, confirm a different schedule. It's a bit disappointing to be shooed away, but it's an important detail to be aware of to avoid an early morning letdown. It seems this specific branch operates on a 9:00 AM schedule, aligning with the general mall hours rather than the standard Starbucks time. This is a small but crucial piece of information for anyone who relies on those early hours for their caffeine fix. Ultimately, this Starbucks is a great spot for its ambiance and location, perfect for a mid-shopping break or a relaxed meet-up. Just be sure to double-check their actual opening hours before you go!

This Starbucks branch, prominently located on the 2nd Floor of SM Lanang Premier, offers a unique and distinct experience compared to other more enclosed locations. The branch generally follows the mall's operating hours, which are typically 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily. It's best to check the mall's official schedule for any holiday or special day adjustments. Because it is an open, lay-out store, and highly visible from all sides of the mall's floors, the place feels less cozy, warm, and inviting than most traditional Starbucks branches. It lacks the intimate, tucked-away feel you might find elsewhere. The combination of the open design and the mall's glass ceiling contributes to significant natural light, making the area feel too bright and hot during peak daylight hours. The atmosphere dramatically improves in the evening, offering a much nicer, cooler, and more relaxing environment. A distinctive feature is the slightly noticeable "shaky" sensation due to the structure standing on poles, which might be disconcerting for some patrons. Since expanding their floor space, they are able to accommodate more customers but on most peak days, they need more.

The ambiance and location of the coffee shop are nice, and I also liked their service, even though you might spend quite a long time in line. I just had a bad experience with a local person while we were in line. So, I was next, and since only two counters were open, the line worked in an alternating manner basically, whoever was at the front of the line would go to a counter once the previous customer finished ordering. So, here's what happened: the older person behind me told me to line up behind someone else. I told her that there's only one line and the baristas hadn't even finished taking the orders of the two people ahead since the two baristas were busy preparing the previous orders. But this older person went ahead and lined up behind one customer, and the person behind her lined up behind another customer. Basically, they skipped my turn. At first, I tried to understand because maybe they were a senior, but when I looked to see if they had a senior card, they didn't. So, were they just being rude? Were they so dehydrated that they needed to go first??? I didn't know locals here, especially older ones, could be rude, because this is not the first time I've encountered it in this city.
